svg.title: The EU: a machine no one operates
svg.desc: A diagram of effects for the European Union's cyber posture, drawn as one reinforcing loop with a grey brake. Member-state contribution raises the shared situational picture; the shared picture raises coordinated rules and response; coordination raises interoperability and trust between national bodies; and trust raises contribution again. The four loop edges run in the same direction, so the loop is reinforcing, marked R and read clockwise. Drawn in grey, meaning a sourced effect on a branch with no evidenced return into the loop: the national veto, the unanimity the Union's collective decisions require, which lowers coordinated rules and response from outside the loop. No edge produces a Union-owned sovereign capability: the machine coordinates national capability it never consolidates into one, an absence the loop leaves open. An increase in member-state contribution raises the shared situational picture, by human intervention. An increase in the shared situational picture raises coordinated rules and response, by human intervention. An increase in coordinated rules and response raises interoperability and trust. An increase in interoperability and trust raises member-state contribution. An increase in the national veto lowers coordinated rules and response.
svg.text: The EU: a machine no one operates
One reinforcing loop of coordination, a grey veto that brakes it, and no sovereign capability of its own
One reinforcing loop: member states lend intelligence and expertise, the shared picture drives coordinated action, action
builds interoperability and trust, and trust draws more contribution.
No edge produces a Union-owned sovereign capability: the machine coordinates hands it never consolidates, and any national veto lowers its output.
natural effect, same direction as the movement of the cause
human intervention, same direction as the movement of the cause
grey: a sourced effect with no evidenced return, opposite to the movement of the cause
